title: Refactor Piece DTOs to Use Nested Optional Pose
description: Refactor compose/rs/lib.rs: Pieces MUST NOT have plane and center as direct DTO fields. Instead they MUST have an optional `pose: Option<PoseDto>` (where PoseDto has optional plane and center). Additionally, the PieceStore's two separate flat caches (flat_plane: Cache<Plane>, flat_center: Cache<Coordinate>) MUST be merged into a single `flat_pose: Cache<PoseFullDto>` that is always computed and cached. Changes: (1) Add PoseDto struct with optional plane/center. (2) Update PieceMetadataDto/PieceShallowDto/PieceFullDto to replace plane+center with pose. (3) Update PieceDiff to replace plane/center with pose. (4) Merge flat_plane+flat_center caches into flat_pose. (5) Update all callers throughout lib.rs. (6) Make all tests pass.
